App Access
Session-only • one approved window • Rust gatekeeper

Authorization

No application access.
Approval is not persisted. Restarting Nova ends the grant. ChatGPT mode also refuses input if the approved browser window stops identifying itself as ChatGPT.

Conversation bridge

1. Put the caret in ChatGPT's message box.
2. Send Nova's latest reply.
3. When ChatGPT responds, select its response text in the browser.
4. Capture the selection back into Nova.
Bridge idle.

Current sandbox

Allowed after approval: focus the exact approved window, paste/type text, press Enter, and copy explicitly selected text from that window.

Not granted: shell, process launch, filesystem access, arbitrary window switching, unrestricted mouse control, or control of a different application.
